dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the graffiti on the wall...

dialogues.speaker: Benthem
dialogues.text: Oh, you noticed the graffiti nearby too? Two kids were playing a "defuse the bomb" game here a while back. Rather cute, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A bomb-defusal game? I mean... there weren't any real bombs, right?

dialogues.speaker: Benthem
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not. Since when do children carry bombs around?

dialogues.speaker: Benthem
dialogues.text: That kid in the purple and pink outfit — she looked older, I think she's the older sister — told the kid in red, "Only crayons."

dialogues.speaker: Benthem
dialogues.text: So one drew bombs, the other drew arrows, and they kept playing like that until nightfall.

dialogues.speaker: Benthem
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I used to love doodling on the walls at home when I was a kid. After traveling to so many places, I realize I miss those days the most...
